stem: Two {{m}} kg trolleys collide and stick together.
Which quantity is conserved in this collision?

options.text: Total momentum, but not total kinetic energy
Both total momentum and total kinetic energy

args.text: Compare ½mv² before and after: it drops.

hints.text: With no external force, which quantity can't change?
Kinetic energy is conserved only in elastic collisions.

ke-always-conserved.text: When bodies stick together, some kinetic energy becomes heat, sound and deformation. Only momentum is conserved.

generic.text: Momentum is conserved in every collision; KE only in elastic ones.

workedSolution.text: No external force: total momentum is conserved.
They stick, so it is perfectly inelastic: some KE is lost.

ke-always-conserved.front: Is KE conserved when two bodies stick together?
ke-always-conserved.back: No. Momentum is conserved; some KE becomes heat, sound and deformation.

generic.front: What is conserved when bodies stick together?
